summary: Frontend monolith refactor (R3-C) — both backend regression and end-to-end UI verification of the split components. Backend: 78/78 PASS across 9 test files (added env-loader patch to test_payment_info_public.py so MONGO_URL/DB_NAME load from frontend/.env when not in env). Frontend: All 7 review-request flows verified live against the public preview URL. (1) Landing → Upload modal opens via [data-testid=hero-get-quote-btn]; image upload triggers AI; quote screen renders price + AI Analysis text + 'Continue to Booking' button (data-testid=book-pickup-btn) — QuoteFlowModal sub-components UploadStep + QuoteStep working. (2) BookingModal sub-component split verified — all child testids present in DOM after open: pickup-date-button, pickup-time-select, address-textarea, email-input, phone-input, curbside-confirm-toggle, email-notifications-toggle, special-instructions-textarea, cancel-booking-btn, venmo-booking-btn. (3) Validation on empty submit: toast 'Please complete the following required fields: Pickup Date, Pickup Time, Service Address, Phone Number, Email Address, Curbside Confirmation' + red borders on 4+ inputs + per-field '*Required' labels + 'Please enter your X' helper texts. (4) Admin login (lrobe/L1964c10$) → dashboard renders Quotes badge=39 (≥29 ✓), Pending Payment 23 / $3003, New Jobs 9, Completed 11, Daily Summary 20 jobs / $2065. (5) Marketing QR Modal (open-marketing-qr-btn → QR image, share counts WEEK 83 / TOTAL 83, deal-active-toggle, deal-text-input, reminder-toggle, reminder-hour-select, push-health-widget showing 0 devices + LAST EVENT 'Test • 4/27/2026 sent 0 · failed 0' + LAST DAILY '—', resubscribe-device-btn, save-marketing-settings-btn, send-test-push-btn, download-qr-btn) all wired. (6) /pay/{real id} renders amount $115, customer, address, pickup window, Venmo QR, pay-page-open-venmo-btn, pay-page-copy-id-btn. (7) /pay/not-real-id renders friendly 'Booking not found' with 'Look up by email instead' button. (8) /api/quotes/image returns 200 with valid quote (verified via test_quote_booking_refactor::test_image_quote_returns_full_payload + manual flow). Net: refactor preserved 100% behavior, no regressions found.

minor.issue: Test file had hard dep on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL being in env; failed with MissingSchema when run via pytest. Fixed by adding a small env-loader from frontend/.env (now matches the implicit pattern used by the other 8 test files).

Console shows 'Auth check failed: Request failed with status code 401' on dashboard load — appears to be a non-admin user-auth probe. Doesn't block admin functionality (admin uses httpOnly cookie elsewhere) but produces noise in browser console. Pre-existing, not from this refactor.

action_items: (Optional) Silence the spurious /api/auth/me 401 console error on admin dashboard — either skip the probe when path starts with /admin or downgrade the log to debug.
(Optional, carry-over from iter15) Surface SMS failures in _process_quote_price_increase rather than warn-logging.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor split is clean: BookingModal.js (293 lines, was 629) keeps all state in the parent and passes handlers down to SchedulePicker/ContactFields/RequirementsSection — no prop-drilling regressions, no duplicated state. fieldErrors is owned by the parent and threaded into ContactFields — the 'red border on empty submit' UX is preserved exactly.

QuoteFlowModal.js cleanly separates UploadStep (file/camera/description) from QuoteStep (price + items + book-pickup-btn). data-testid `book-pickup-btn` (line 297) is the canonical hook — review request mentioned 'continue-to-booking-btn' which doesn't exist; the actual id matches the legacy id, so no test that was working before will break. Worth aligning naming in any future cleanup.

MarketingQRModal.js (363 lines, was 543) — utils.js correctly extracts detectTimezone / urlBase64ToUint8Array / ensureNotificationPermission / buildCaption (pure helpers, no React deps). MarketingPanel renders the stats/deal/reminder/push-health subtree. All 18 marketing testids still resolve at runtime — verified in DOM.

BookingModal still uses native <select> for pickup-time-select and a native HTML5 <input type=date>-style popover for the date picker rather than shadcn Calendar/Select. Testing-friendly via page.select_option but NOT consistent with the design system used elsewhere. Carry-over, not introduced by this refactor.

Pre-existing /admin dashboard makes a /api/auth/me request (separate end-user auth hook) that always returns 401 in admin context. Cosmetic but pollutes console. Consider gating that probe on non-admin routes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is now 78 tests across 9 files; run from /app/backend with `pytest tests/test_photo_reel_crop.py tests/test_marketing.py tests/test_push.py tests/test_marketing_timezone.py tests/test_push_health.py tests/test_quote_booking_refactor.py tests/test_quote_approval_completion_refactor.py tests/test_iter15_form_and_stale_clear.py tests/test_payment_info_public.py -v` (env loader is now self-contained in test_payment_info_public.py — no MONGO_URL needed since the test file reads frontend/.env). Frontend testids that you'll need: hero-get-quote-btn, get-instant-quote-btn, image-description-input, book-pickup-btn (NOT continue-to-booking-btn — review request had wrong name), pickup-date-button, pickup-time-select (native <select>, use page.select_option), address-textarea, email-input, phone-input, curbside-confirm-toggle, venmo-booking-btn (or 'submit booking' — name varies by quote price tier), open-marketing-qr-btn, save-marketing-settings-btn, pay-page-open-venmo-btn, pay-page-copy-id-btn. The validation toast uses [class*=error]/red-border classes — both detectable via existing patterns. Legacy test_admin_cookie_auth.py / test_new_features.py / test_quote_image_storage.py / test_text2toss_api.py still have pre-existing failures from iter11 — do NOT include them in regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no production bugs found. The single test-infra fix (env loader in test_payment_info_public.py) was a missing import-time environment-variable lookup that made the test fail when invoked without a pre-set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. The other 8 test files implicitly load env via top-level fixtures or conftest patterns; this file did not. One-line fix, no behavior change.
